definitions.explanation: A small shelf or miniature shrine installed high on a wall in Japanese homes and businesses to enshrine Shinto talismans ({御札|おふだ}). Used for daily prayers and offerings to the kami.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{神棚|かみだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。
examples.english: I put my hands together in prayer at the kami shelf every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{御札|おふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{神棚|かみだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{祀|まつ}った。
examples.english: I enshrined a new talisman on the kami shelf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧な{神棚|かみだな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供|そな}えていた→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather's house had an impressive kami shelf, and he would offer water and rice there every day.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧ (god, kami) and ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧ (shelf). Traditionally placed high on a wall in the living room or a prominent room. The Buddhist equivalent is ⟦{仏壇|ぶつだん}→仏壇：07116_butsudan⟧ (Buddhist altar). Some households have both.

Offerings typically include ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧ (rice), ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water), ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt), and {榊|さかき} (sakaki branches).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神棚|かみだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{祀|まつ}る: to enshrine on the kami shelf
- {神棚|かみだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧: to pray at the kami shelf
- {神棚|かみだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{供|そな}える→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧: to make offerings at the kami shelf
- {神棚|かみだな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧: to set up a kami shelf
